panel.subhead: Learn more effectively by working through code live, one-to-one with your teacher.

field.name: Name
field.username_hint: 5–30 characters. Letters, numbers, dot, dash, or underscore. This is what you sign in with.

login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Sign in to pick up where you left off. Your academy manager controls academy access and roles.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.description: One account works across every DLAB academy — with its own role in each.
signup.role_notice: You don't pick a role here. An academy manager gives you your role when they approve or invite you.

invitation.title: Accept academy invitation
invitation.description: Your academy manager selected your initial role.
invitation.explanation: Accepting adds your verified account to the academy with the role selected by its manager.

welcome.title: You're all set
welcome.description: Your account is ready. Your identity stays separate from the roles each academy gives you.
welcome.no_academy: You do not belong to an academy yet. Choose an academy during signup or ask an academy manager for an invitation.
welcome.choose_username_description: Your account does not have a username yet. Pick one and you can sign in with it from now on.
welcome.unavailable_description: We could not load your Cove account.
welcome.unavailable_hint: Check your connection and try signing in again.

pending.title: Academy approval
pending.description: Your Cove account is ready. Academy features become available after a manager reviews your application.
pending.unavailable_description: We could not load your academy access.
pending.unavailable_hint: Check your connection and try signing in again.
pending.load_failed: We could not load your academy access.
pending.update_failed: The application could not be updated.
pending.no_auto_refresh: This page does not refresh automatically.

state.approved_description: {{academy}} approved your membership. Your current session already has access.
state.suspended_description: Your access to {{academy}} is suspended. Contact an academy manager if you believe this is a mistake.
state.none_description: No academy membership or application is associated with this account.
state.pending_description: {{academy}} is reviewing your application. Student is the default role, but the manager may select another academy role.
state.application_approved_description: {{academy}} approved your application. Your academy membership is being prepared.
state.rejected_description: {{academy}} did not approve your application. You may apply again if your circumstances change.
state.cancelled_description: Your application to {{academy}} was cancelled. You may apply again.

error.credentials_rejected: The username or password is incorrect.
error.username_taken: That username is already taken. Choose another one.
error.signup_verify_email: Check your email to verify your account, then sign in.
error.social_start_failed: Unable to start social signup. Try again.
error.social_unavailable: This sign-in provider is not available yet.
error.academies_unavailable: Academies are unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
error.invitation_missing: This invitation link is missing or expired.
error.invitation_failed: The invitation could not be accepted. Confirm that you signed in with the invited email.
error.identity_conflict: This email already has a Cove account. Sign in with its existing method.
error.sign_in_failed: Sign in could not be completed. Try again.
error.academy_required: Choose your academy and try social signup again.
error.oauth_failed: Social signup could not be completed. Try again.
